validateDiagnostics: error: Header set both ways [AttributeName("custom").AttributeName("headers_wo")] | authorization collides with another header name. Keep a secret header in headers_wo only, and give it one spelling: HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so headers and headers_wo must not name the same header even in different case.

warning: Credential-carrying webhook header for "invalid" is stored in state [AttributeName("custom").AttributeName("headers")] | Authorization is set through headers and appears to carry a credential. Terraform writes it to state. Use headers_wo with headers_wo_versions to send the secret without storing it. Write-only attributes need Terraform 1.11 or later. Terraform shows one warning per distinct message, so check any other webhook with the same name as well.
